items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The… Roger Miller—the King of the Road, you know. That was the period—the ’60s.

ctx.x: And that’s, that’s the part that the fruit fell far from the tree, but somehow it was a jazz connection with the whistle. With the [imitates]. [laughs] And those Western guys, yeah. And they were [inaudible]. Hillbillies came to sing for, on the show. The… Roger Miller—the King of the Road, you know. That was the period—the ’60s. Then Bluesette came out a little bit, you know, around there.
